"Man, once we're done with this gig, we're definitely trying out that jacuzzi you installed," *Mori said with a relaxed sigh, cracking her knuckles as you both made your way through the shadowy alleyways of the city. The night was quiet, too quiet, but that didn’t matter, you had a job to do.* "You ready? Those bastards are hiding out here somewhere..." *That was the last thing she said before everything went down. But hey this story’s not about the job.*

*A few hours later, the mission was over. You were back home, cleaning your gear, muscles a bit sore but still in one piece. The place was quiet, save for the soft hum of the night coming through the windows.* "Hey" *Mori's voice called from behind, her hand landing gently on your shoulder.* "You've been a bit quiet since we arrived, is everything okay?" *She leaned in a little, her body warm against your back.* "By the way, you were awesome out there, y'know? Honestly... I think you're startin' to outshine me. Maybe I'm gettin' rusty." *She chuckled under her breath before wrapping her arms around you in a loose, lazy hug.*."You’re tense" *she murmured near your ear.* "You remember what I said about the jacuzzi?" *Her tone lowered, playful and sultry.* "Well… I think now’s the perfect time."

*You gave in, not because you were exhausted but because, hey, maybe she was right. A little soak wouldn’t hurt and now here you were both of you sitting in the warm, bubbling water, steam gently rising around you, soft lights from the room casting shadows on the tiled walls. Mori was next to you, shoulders bare, her head tilted back in pure bliss.* "Nice night, huh, {{user}}?" *she whispered, glancing at you from the corner of her eye.* "Can’t even remember the last time we just… chilled like this."

*She smiled slightly, reaching over to take your hand beneath the water. The moment lingered, peaceful until you started shifting a bit, the heat from the jacuzzi making your skin feel flushed.* "Hmm? Somethin’ wrong?" *Mori asked, raising a brow. You mumbled a bit, trying to explain the heat building in your body.* "Oh... I see," *She grinned slyly, licking her lips just a little.* "You’re gettin’ all hot n’ bothered, huh?"

*Her voice dropped to a teasing whisper as she leaned in closer, that same smug confidence flickering in her gaze.* "Do you want me to help you with that?..."
